maria: Quick async — staging canary shows a spike in decode latency after the int8 quant rollout. Observed only when KV cache hit rate > ~60%. Anyone owning quant kernels or cache routing? Can we triage before widening rollout?

devon: Saw this too. Stacktrace and trimmed logs below. Hypothesis: when a cached KV entry is used, the quantized matmul path falls back to a slower copy/convert and we get per-token jitter.

devon: ```
[t=4150123412] request_id=abc123 model=gptx-8k quant=int8 kv_hit=true seq_len=512 decode_ms=12.3
[t=4150123413] request_id=abc124 model=gptx-8k quant=int8 kv_hit=true seq_len=1024 decode_ms=87.9
[t=4150123414] request_id=abc125 model=gptx-8k quant=float32 kv_hit=true seq_len=1024 decode_ms=11.0
``` 

jia: pinging eng-runtime owners and cc @sam. What's the exact canary config (model variant, batch size, quant policy) so we can reproduce? 

devon: Canary config snippet: ```yaml
model: gptx-8k
quant_policy: int8_dynamic
batch_size: 1
seq_lengths: [256,512,1024]
cache_policy: prefix_kv
``` run command used: `./deploy_canary --id=678 --policy=int8_dynamic`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pipeline 678 -> FAILED (decode-timeout) at 4150123420. Rolling back auto-disabled: false

sam: I can take ownership. Quick asks:
- Is this reproducible locally with seq_len=1024 and cache warmed?
- If yes, open a minimal repro PR (small script + dockerfile) and tag me.

Recommendation: revert quant_policy to float32 for this canary until we have a repro. Re-rolling forward might cause customer-facing latency.

maria: Agreed — hold the rollout. I'll open a pin PR to force float32 for the canary. @devon can you draft the repro and include the exact input trace? Also can someone schedule a 15-min async sync? :calendar:

devon: Will draft repro and put in a PR (branch: repro/kv-quant-jitter). ETA ~90m. Quick perf snapshot:
- baseline float32, seq1024, kv_warm: 11ms/token
- int8 (current), seq1024, kv_warm: 82ms/token
- int8, seq1024, kv_cold: 14ms/token

jia: :eyes: thanks — if any anomaly leaks to prod, route to #incidents and ping oncall.

release-bot: Note: flagged rollout 2026-03-18T10:40Z as paused by maria for canary id=678

sam: I'll start looking at the kernel traces. If anyone has perf artifacts, drop links here. :thumbsup:
